data.source_feature_scaling: Already /4 exactly once in original encoder capture; not re-scaled here
limitations: Fixed identity graph with independently sampled CPU patches; no actual tracked trajectory or BA/pose output.
Captured CNN time, decoding and graph setup are outside corr+Update timing; per-frame end-to-end VO rate is unmeasured.
CPU RNG/reduction results are not claimed CUDA byte-exact or an NPU execution result.
Cold+3 warm repeats of the same features are workload observations, not a sustained real-time benchmark.

data.scope: Read-only before/after observations; no clock/governor/cooling changes

provenance.source_image_provenance_scope: Recorded before/after board SHA plus input-manifest binding; saved preprocessed NPY files rehashed, no image decode.

correlation_convention.reference: Independent NumPy channel-dot + bilinear loops; explicit FP32 row-major average pooling.
correlation_convention.sample_policy: Edges 0,1,2,E//2,E//2+1,E-2,E-1; all offsets, patch positions, levels; plus all self level1 center correlations.

data.bottleneck: Current CPU correlation reference dominates: two levels, Python offset/chunk loops and Torch gather/channel reductions. Its timing includes pyramid pooling; it is not a hardware or algorithmic lower bound.
limits: Fixed identity projections on three frames, zero initial net, no feedback iterations; not a tracked trajectory.
Correlation samples and all self centers checked; whole learned Update not independently re-executed. Saved outputs are finite/nonzero and repeats byte-identical.
Dynamic timing excludes CNN, static patch/graph setup and BA. Encoder and motion timings from separate processes cannot be reported as measured end-to-end latency.
No SE3 estimate, BA, full VO lifecycle, trajectory/GT accuracy or 20 Hz validation. Optimizing only Update/CNN would leave this measured correlation reference dominant.
Four calls per scenario on one observed board configuration, no controlled thermal or statistically established benchmark.
